benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Dodge
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a dodge roll.

benefits.name: Light Melee Damage
benefits.description: You inflict +1 damage with light melee weapons.

system.description:
You are curious and love discovering ways to turn found things into art, tools, or weapons.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a dodge roll.
  • You are trained in crafting.
  • You inflict +1 damage with light melee weapons.
